name: Select Screen
description: Select which monitor Geometry Dash uses and choose windowed, exclusive fullscreen, or borderless fullscreen.

screen.name: Screen
screen.description: Monitor number, ordered the same way the operating system reports connected displays. Screen 1 is normally the primary display.

display-mode.name: Display Mode
display-mode.description: Exclusive changes the selected display mode. Borderless fills the selected monitor without changing its display mode.

refresh-rate.name: Refresh Rate
refresh-rate.description: Exclusive fullscreen refresh rate. Use 0 to use the selected monitor's current/preferred refresh rate.

restore-on-focus.name: Restore After Alt-Tab
restore-on-focus.description: Reapply the selected monitor whenever Geometry Dash regains focus. This prevents fullscreen from returning to the primary monitor.

apply-immediately.name: Apply Settings Immediately
apply-immediately.description: Apply screen and display-mode changes as soon as you close/change the mod settings.
